contexts.text: A white light of a beautiful yellow tinge = the first life (there) as being celestial together with spiritual.
Another light with yellowish points, like stars, seen. SE 3636.
A chamber where there was a yellow luminosity, as from coals, seen.
When they remove themselves from the light of Heaven, there succeeds a yellow light as from sulphur...
The upper part of his face was yellowish, like the faces of those inhabitants of our Earth that are not quite white.
Good is presented there... as blue, yellow, and red.
The roses of a golden yellow colour formed the next circle...
The second gymnasium was surrounded by a yellowish light, like that of the morning after sunrise.
The love of the world (in such an infant) is as it were yellow.
The virgin... was clad in a whitish yellowish garment.
His delight was represented by a colour as it were yellow.
The quality (of Gustavus Adolphus) was shown by a little dog of a yellowish colour...
A golden yellow atmosphere...
A house was shown, of a yellow colour...
A grate of teeth, yellowish, like teeth, seen.
The flame was yellowish, like that from wood. Explained.
A woman clad in a short cloak of a bilious yellowish colour.
The other (horrible woman) was represented as a yellow ball (of foul intestines).
A yellow dog, seen.
The quality of his life was represented by an animal seen in a dim light as yellow...
Above the forehead there opened a kind of beautiful yellowish lucidity...
A luminous something, yellowish (appeared) round about that = a sphere of good, or of truth, which could not as yet penetrate...
A sulphureous yellow appears there, from the fire of hatreds...
Coarse spikes of salt, of a yellow colour, came out of the animal's head.
Feathers covered with the yellow of gold () = spiritual good, from which are these truths.
